$comment: Input to scripts/check_release_health.py. One entry per RELEASE LANE:
a tag namespace plus the workflow that is supposed to publish it.
release-and-publish.yml accepts a reviewed version from protected main.
The founder-approved release App creates only its annotated tag.
The tag run publishes through the protected pypi environment and verifies
the PyPI and GitHub bytes. The detector remains state-based: it asks
whether a release is still unpublished, not whether one run failed.

openadapt-desktop releases from packages/desktop: desktop-release.yml publishes one openadapt-desktop-vX.Y.Z release per version with the wheel, sdist, and native installers, and the same wheel and sdist to PyPI. It does not track main, because unrelated packages share main; the desktop release-intent check in packages.yml stops a feat or fix from merging without a version bump.

lanes.name: PyPI package

acknowledged_tags.v0.36.1: 2024-07-06 legacy monorepo tag. No release object was ever created and 0.36.1 was never published to PyPI (the index jumps 0.35.x -> 0.39.1). Permanently historical: acknowledged here rather than left to alert forever, because a guard that is always red is a guard nobody reads.

lanes.remediation:
# First merge the reviewed version, changelog, lockfile, and candidate state. Then create the tag from exact main.
gh workflow run release-and-publish.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/OpenAdapt --ref main -f version=<reviewed-version>
# If that exact tag run partially failed, rerun it. Do not create a recovery tag.
gh run rerun --repo OpenAdaptAI/OpenAdapt <tag-run-id>

lanes.name: OpenAdapt Desktop (PyPI and installers)
lanes.remediation:
# A half-published version resumes by re-running the failed jobs of its run:
gh run rerun --failed --repo OpenAdaptAI/OpenAdapt <desktop-release run id>
# A merged version that never started releases with:
gh workflow run desktop-release.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/OpenAdapt --ref main
